note: Wave perks (engine/perks.js). Ride on the waves: offered while waves are on (trashWave.json; ?nowaves=1 turns both off); with the flag off nothing here creates state or touches a stat. After every everyWaves-th wave clear (counted over the whole session, across areas) the player is offered `choices` different perks and takes one by tap, click or the 1-2-3 keys; ignoring it for autoPickSeconds takes the first. The game never pauses. Perks are session-only run modifiers held on the live game (g.perks): never saved, never sent, gone with the run. A perk can be taken again until its maxStacks. stats names how each effect combines (mul multiplies, add sums) and the stat the hooks read: damage (every player hit), moveSpeed (walking and sprinting), shield (bonus HP that absorbs damage before health; the run save's max HP stays untouched, so a pick also heals this much and each wave clear refills the shield), staminaRegen (the player's own staminaRegen field, multiplied once per pick), magazine (extra pistol rounds, as a fraction: every shot earns a share of a round back, so the magazine lasts this much longer and never holds more than it can), reload (pistol and rifle reload seconds), waveHeal (multiplies the wave-clear heal), dropChance (chance that an ordinary wave kill may leave a coin drop; the per-wave cap and spacing in trashWave.json drops still apply). Names and texts are shown as written (cards are about 120 px wide).
